repos_data.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

repo_meta_data.description: 🦎 A lightweight, streaming-native, multi-protocol gateway for AI, APIs, and real-time data. Route LLM requests across providers, govern MCP tools, and connect Kafka, MQTT, and HTTP through one high-performance engine with shared security and observability.
